content.en: Capital Account Convertibility (CAC) allows residents and non-residents to freely move capital into and out of the country. In India, the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** maintains a managed approach, allowing full convertibility on the **Current Account** while keeping the **Capital Account** partially restricted to prevent volatility.
